LTTH Version 1.4.1 Release Notes

LTTH remains at 1.4.1. Stream Monsters 1.11.0 is published separately as a verified Open Beta plugin package.

- NEW: Fresh Stream Monsters setups use a 90-second incubation default while every stored creator duration and existing egg ready_at remain unchanged
- NEW: Deutsch and English are active by default, with one or two overlay languages selectable from German, English, Spanish and French
- NEW: Portrait Arcade Rally reserves the upper 74 percent for gameplay and the lower 26 percent for TikTok chat
- NEW: Rules v8 battles continue until K.O. or forfeit; Arena Collapse accelerates living fights from round five
- IMPROVED: Sealed A/B/C choices, readable action cards, exact player and monster stat prompts, and deterministic replay recovery make the next action explicit
- IMPROVED: Element-specific WebGPU particles, trails and light share one timeline with the Canvas2D/CSS fallback
- FAIRNESS: Gifts affect eggs, timing and presentation only; rating limits remain separate from XP and permanent progress
- COMPATIBILITY: The stable streamalchemy plugin ID, player data, old configs, eggs, monsters, replays and every published archive through 1.10.0 remain preserved
- PACKAGE: streamalchemy-1.11.0.zip is bound to audited source commit 413bc515334563cd3138384bcc59014c1f85c9aa with SHA-256 f0c0991e0b0e047ee81b26103714bd2661a43079eb53945437dd39c88f69659e
